entry.title: rollbacks in practice
entry.content:
I keep coming back to rollbacks, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Rollbacks shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: a small guide to rollbacks

why it matters

Rollbacks shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

entry.title: what i learned about rollbacks
entry.content:
Every few months rollbacks bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Rollbacks shows up across devops work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
